title: Strict scalar comparison for finite ordered Koszul towers
statement: Let C be a small site, R→B any map of sheaves of commutative rings, and a a list of r global sections of R, allowing r=0. Use the strict complexes, tensor towers and coaugmentations of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], and the restriction, image list and actual ordered coordinates of [def-weil-pbc-flat-scalar-koszul-models]. There is a natural isomorphism Res^Tow(T_B(N)) ≅ T_R(Res N) of complexes of strict inverse towers, whose composite with every R-coordinate is the restricted B-coordinate. It carries the actual restricted strict coaugmentation to the R-coaugmentation, degree by degree and at every tower index. No flatness, boundedness or derived-category hypothesis is required.

The strict tower, evaluation and unit normalization are made explicit.

proof.text: 1. Expand the ordered positive Koszul tensor by its Boolean-subset basis. The finite dual and tensor totalization have, in degree n, the direct sum of N^(n+degree(e)); the actual projections are coordinate from [def-weil-pbc-flat-scalar-koszul-models]. Restriction preserves this finite decomposition. Identity on these summands gives mutually inverse maps. This works for unbounded N because the Koszul factor is finite.

2. The differential on these coordinates is d_N together with signed multiplication by the appropriate image of a_i^(m+1). The transition for a subset multiplies by the product of its selected a_i. Scalar restriction preserves each multiplication and sign, so the maps are chain maps and commute with tower transitions. The identity coordinates are natural in N. The coaugmentation has only the empty-subset coordinate, the identity, proving its displayed compatibility. No flatness is used.

theorem strictScalarKoszulComparison (φ : R ⟶ B) (r : ℕ)
    (a : Fin r → (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    ∃ h : ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor B r (imageSections φ a) ⋙
        restrictTowerComplex φ ≅
      restrictComplex φ ⋙ ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor R r a,
      (∀ (N : ringedSiteComplex B) (m : ℕ) (e : Fin r → Bool) (n : ℤ),
        ((h.hom.app N).f n).app (op m) ≫
            coordinate R r a ((restrictComplex φ).obj N) m e n =
          (restriction φ).map (coordinate B r (imageSections φ a) N m e n)) ∧
      (∀ (N : ringedSiteComplex B) (m : ℕᵒᵖ) (n : ℤ),
        (restriction φ).map
            ((ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent B r (imageSections φ a) N m).f n) ≫
            ((h.hom.app N).f n).app m =
          (ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent R r a ((restrictComplex φ).obj N) m).f n)
